accuracy: Augment every original aggregate, retaining all seven fields/four applicable variants/two clouds/two pressure-storage modes/three grids/two regions. Hessian Frobenius RMS=sqrt(RMSxx^2+2RMSxz^2+RMSzz^2); normalize only by nonzero analytic Hessian RMS over the actual receiver coordinates. Scalar error uses its own analytic trace RMS; xz trace0 has no invented relative denominator. Undefined orders/relative errors are null. Apparent orders use actual dp ratios and absolute RMS errors; only three spacings, changing support regions and fixed h/dp make these descriptive, not convergence acceptance.
literal_vs_current: Literal receiver C with r2 is kept distinct from receiver C+Eta2, pair C+Eta2 and compatible tangent projection. Tensor/scalar expression identity is algebra, not accuracy. The tangent case is only analytic zero-normal-gradient fields at Ace0; it is not a Neumann wall/normal/acceleration test. Current kernel is archived float Wendland, h=float(1.8dp), J1/constant V/k, not an ideal double kernel or a full paper reproduction. A full-support receiver may still use truncated-support neighbor correction matrices in the pair-C variant.
pressure_storage: Production-float pressure and double manufactured values remain separate. Float quantization is reported directly; differences between aggregate error norms are not the RMS of an unavailable pointwise float-minus-double field. Affine forward bounds apply only to x/z; computed bound columns for quadratic/cosine fields are not accuracy bounds. No new physical, percent-accuracy, quadratic-exactness or order threshold is introduced.
spectra: For each actual64x64 matrix compute full nonsymmetric eig(A) and separately eigh((A+A.T)/2), preserving raw near-zero values and residual norms. Sorted ranks do not pair eigenvectors of different operators. Report row-null, constant-volume column-conservation, asymmetry and symmetric-part Rayleigh behavior separately. gamma(64)*norm2(A) is an explicitly labeled numerical-resolution indicator, not a rigorous nonnormal eigenvalue error bound or stability gate. Exact source constant-input null and approximate reconstructed coefficient row sums are distinct facts; neither establishes column conservation. No coupled stability or general conservation acceptance.

No smoothing, interpolation or fitted bias removal.
cost_limits: Record actual source/owned/compiler/link timings, total input CSV bytes and196608bytes of six dense double matrices.
